releases.name: v0.8.2 - Fallback Recommendation Preservation, In-Flight Cancellation, and Subagent Support
releases.body:
### What's Changed in v0.8.2

- **Recommendation Preservation in Fallback Mode (`ui.tsx`, `backend.ts`):**
  - In `remediate-then-fallback` policy, preserves recommended selections (including multiselect answers) across all classified questions once the remediation budget is exhausted. The V1 TUI permits that fallback instead of installing a manual-answer lock.
- **Race Condition & Duplicate Event Hardening (`ui.tsx`, `backend.ts`):**
  - Keeps rejected remediation retryable when duplicate question events arrive during network transport.
  - Preserves V2 form reply ownership (`pending.has(form.id)`) and user-interaction cancellation across duplicate form events and asynchronous `form.sync` / reply completion.
- **Ambiguous Option Label Rejection (`form-adapter.ts`):**
  - Rejects ambiguous V2 label-to-value mappings even when first-option fallback is enabled, safely classifying duplicated labels as `unclassified`.
- **Subagent Support & Lifecycle Cancellation (`session-scope.ts`, `types.ts`, `backend.ts`):**
  - Adds documented `includeSubagents` opt-in configuration while preserving root-session isolation by default.
  - Cancels in-flight V1 question handling on session deletion, user messages, settlement, and plugin disposal; rejected history lookups cannot revive cancelled work.
- **Expanded Automated Test Suite:**
  - Added 13 debugging regression tests covering remediation exhaustion, ambiguous labels, duplicate forms, and subagent session scopes.
  - 169 of 169 tests passing (100% pass) across unit, fallback, and integration scenarios.
  - 0 linter warnings / errors across 21 files.

### Highlights of v0.8.1

• **Reserved Form Field Key Preservation (`form-adapter.ts`)**:
  • Preserves own serialized answers for reserved field keys (e.g. `__proto__`) using safe object property assignment (`Object.hasOwn`).
• **Deleted Session Overlay Cleanup (`ui.tsx`)**:
  • Deleting an owning session (`session.deleted` event) now immediately releases the question lockfile and clears TUI overlay state, preventing orphaned overlays.
• **100% Passing Test Suite**:
  • 152 of 152 automated unit, fallback, visibility, and regression tests passing.
  • 10 of 10 isolated sandbox scenarios passing.
  • 0 linter warnings / errors across 19 files.

releases.name: v0.6.0 - Flexible Detection, Multi-Step Fallback & Unattended Safety
releases.body:
### Highlights of v0.6.0

- **Flexible Recommendation Matching:** Recognizes recommendations regardless of whether they appear as exact suffixes (`[SQ:recommended]`), prefixes (`(Recommended)`, `(Önerilen)`, `[SQ:recommended] Option`), lowercase variations, descriptions (`description: "(Recommended)"`), or localized Turkish markers.
- **Multi-Step & Multi-Field Form Fallback:** In complex multi-step questions (Step 1, Step 2, Step 3) or multi-field V2 forms, steps with explicit recommendations are honored, while steps without explicit markers fall back to the logical first option. Ensures long unattended agent runs never stall or deadlock.
- **Unattended Safety & Policy Configuration:** Added support for `fallbackToFirstOption: true`, `fallbackOnManual: true`, and `unclassifiedQuestionPolicy: 'fallback-first' | 'remediate-then-fallback' | 'remediate' | 'ignore'` in configuration.
- **Comprehensive Overlay State Surface:** The TUI overlay now visibly surfaces all handled selectable question states with dedicated color branding:
  - **AUTO** (cyan border, green checklist, live countdown timer)
  - **MANUAL** (yellow border, manual approval required)
  - **UNCLASSIFIED** (cyan border, agent remediation in progress)
  - **ERROR** (red border, diagnostic failure message)
- **100% Passing Test Suite:** 148 of 148 automated unit, fallback, visibility, and regression tests passing with 0 warnings/errors.

releases.name: v0.5.0 — Unclassified Question Policy & Session Chain Resets
releases.body:
### OpenCode Smart Questions v0.5.0

#### What's Changed
- **Configurable Unclassified Policy**: Added `unclassifiedQuestionPolicy: 'remediate' | 'ignore'` setting across V1 backend and V2 UI layers to control whether unclassified questions trigger protocol remediation prompts or passive waiting.
- **Session Chain Resets**: In `chat.message` and user turn handlers, unclassified remediation chains now properly reset on new user turns, preventing remediation starvation in long sessions.
- **Fail-Safe Config Normalization**: Strict validation of `unclassifiedQuestionPolicy` ensures invalid configurations fail-closed without altering auto-reply policies.
- **Automated Verification**: 136 of 136 unit and regression tests pass with 0 warnings and 0 errors on Oxlint and strict TypeScript compilation.
